value.rationale: A natural three-parameter count law has an open set of distinct, interior distributions with identical first three population moments; the explicit small moment triple makes the inference obstruction concrete. Full-law pole separation rules out trivial coordinate redundancy. This is a substantive limitation for three-moment identification, not a claim about the paper’s likelihood-based estimation methods.
